From SimpleC.Verification Require Import VCPrelude.
Require Import Goal DLLSupplement.
Import naive_C_Rules.
Import ListNotations.
Local Open Scope sac.
Local Open Scope Z_scope.

(* A finite byte map, with no permissions outside the listed addresses. *)
Fixpoint entry_mem (bs : list (Z * Z)) : mem :=
  match bs with
  | nil => empty_mem
  | (p, b) :: tl =>
      fun x => if Z.eqb x p then value b else entry_mem tl x
  end.

Definition entry_state (m : mem) : naive_C_Rules.model :=
  {| ConAssertion.s_mem := m;
     ConAssertion.s_STS := Sets.full;
     ConAssertion.s_token := Sets.empty |}.

Lemma entry_state_join : forall a b c,
  mem_join a b c ->
  naive_C_Rules.join (entry_state a) (entry_state b) (entry_state c).
Proof.
  intros a b c H.
  unfold naive_C_Rules.join, ConAssertion.state_join, entry_state; cbn.
  split; [exact H |].
  unfold ConAssertion.TokenSet_join, ConAssertion.STS_state_join.
  sets_unfold; tauto.
Qed.

Lemma entry_state_emp : emp (entry_state empty_mem).
Proof.
  unfold naive_C_Rules.emp, naive_C_Rules.is_unit,
    ConAssertion.state_empty, entry_state; cbn.
  split; [apply empty_mem_empty |].
  sets_unfold; tauto.
Qed.

Lemma entry_state_byte : forall p b,
  naive_C_Rules.mstore p b (entry_state (single_byte_mem p b)).
Proof.
  intros p b.
  unfold naive_C_Rules.mstore, entry_state.
  exists b; split; [apply Byte.eqm_refl |].
  repeat split; try reflexivity; sets_unfold; tauto.
Qed.

Lemma entry_state_sep : forall (P Q : naive_C_Rules.expr) a b c,
  mem_join a b c -> P (entry_state a) -> Q (entry_state b) ->
  (P ** Q) (entry_state c).
Proof.
  intros P Q a b c Hjoin HP HQ.
  pose proof (entry_state_join a b c Hjoin) as Hstate.
  exists (entry_state a), (entry_state b); tauto.
Qed.

Lemma entry_mem_absent : forall bs x,
  ~ In x (map fst bs) -> entry_mem bs x = Noperm.
Proof.
  induction bs as [| [p b] tl IH]; intros x H.
  - reflexivity.
  - cbn [entry_mem].
    destruct (Z.eqb x p) eqn:E.
    + apply Z.eqb_eq in E; subst x.
      exfalso; apply H; cbn; left; reflexivity.
    + apply IH; intro Hin; apply H; cbn; right; exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma entry_mem_app_join : forall l r,
  (forall x, In x (map fst l) -> ~ In x (map fst r)) ->
  mem_join (entry_mem l) (entry_mem r) (entry_mem (l ++ r)).
Proof.
  induction l as [| [p b] tl IH]; intros r Hd.
  - apply mem_join_emp1.
  - unfold mem_join; intro x; cbn [entry_mem List.app].
    destruct (Z.eqb x p) eqn:E.
    + apply Z.eqb_eq in E; subst x.
      assert (Hr : entry_mem r p = Noperm).
      { apply entry_mem_absent; apply Hd; cbn; left; reflexivity. }
      rewrite Hr.
      do 4 right; exists b; repeat split; reflexivity.
    + assert (Ht : forall y, In y (map fst tl) -> ~ In y (map fst r)).
      { intros y Hy; apply Hd; cbn; right; exact Hy. }
      exact (IH r Ht x).
Qed.

Lemma entry_mem_sep : forall (P Q : naive_C_Rules.expr) l r,
  (forall x, In x (map fst l) -> ~ In x (map fst r)) ->
  P (entry_state (entry_mem l)) -> Q (entry_state (entry_mem r)) ->
  (P ** Q) (entry_state (entry_mem (l ++ r))).
Proof.
  intros P Q l r Hd HP HQ.
  eapply entry_state_sep; [apply entry_mem_app_join; exact Hd | exact HP | exact HQ].
Qed.

Definition entry_word (p a b c d : Z) : list (Z * Z) :=
  [(p, a); (p + 1, b); (p + 2, c); (p + 3, d)].

Lemma entry_word_store : forall p a b c d v,
  merge_int a b c d v ->
  naive_C_Rules.store_4byte p v
    (entry_state (entry_mem (entry_word p a b c d))).
Proof.
  intros p a b c d v Hmerge.
  unfold naive_C_Rules.store_4byte.
  exists a, b, c, d; split; [exact Hmerge |].
  eapply entry_mem_sep with
    (l := [(p, a)]) (r := [(p + 1, b); (p + 2, c); (p + 3, d)]).
  - cbn; intros x Hin Hout.
    destruct Hin as [Hin | []]; subst x.
    destruct Hout as [Hout | [Hout | [Hout | []]]]; lia.
  - apply entry_state_byte.
  - eapply entry_mem_sep with
      (l := [(p + 1, b)]) (r := [(p + 2, c); (p + 3, d)]).
    + cbn; intros x Hin Hout.
      destruct Hin as [Hin | []]; subst x.
      destruct Hout as [Hout | [Hout | []]]; lia.
    + apply entry_state_byte.
    + eapply entry_mem_sep with (l := [(p + 2, c)]) (r := [(p + 3, d)]).
      * cbn; intros x Hin Hout.
        destruct Hin as [Hin | []]; subst x.
        destruct Hout as [Hout | []]; lia.
      * apply entry_state_byte.
      * apply entry_state_byte.
Qed.

(* Big endian int (-2147483648), followed by the two null pointer words. *)
Definition singleton_bytes : list (Z * Z) :=
  (entry_word 4096 128 0 0 0 ++ entry_word 4100 0 0 0 0) ++
  entry_word 4104 0 0 0 0.

Lemma singleton_fields :
  (4096 # Int |-> (-2147483648) ** 4100 # Ptr |-> 0 ** 4104 # Ptr |-> 0)
    (entry_state (entry_mem singleton_bytes)).
Proof.
  unfold singleton_bytes.
  eapply entry_mem_sep with
    (l := entry_word 4096 128 0 0 0 ++ entry_word 4100 0 0 0 0)
    (r := entry_word 4104 0 0 0 0).
  - intros x Hin Hout.
    cbn [entry_word List.app map fst In] in Hin, Hout.
    destruct Hin as [Hin | [Hin | [Hin | [Hin |
      [Hin | [Hin | [Hin | [Hin | []]]]]]]]];
      destruct Hout as [Hout | [Hout | [Hout | [Hout | []]]]]; lia.
  - eapply entry_mem_sep with
      (l := entry_word 4096 128 0 0 0) (r := entry_word 4100 0 0 0 0).
    + intros x Hin Hout.
      cbn [entry_word map fst In] in Hin, Hout.
      destruct Hin as [Hin | [Hin | [Hin | [Hin | []]]]];
        destruct Hout as [Hout | [Hout | [Hout | [Hout | []]]]]; lia.
    + unfold naive_C_Rules.store_int; split.
      * unfold isvalidptr_int, aligned_4; vm_compute; intuition discriminate.
      * apply entry_word_store; reflexivity.
    + unfold naive_C_Rules.store_ptr; split.
      * unfold isvalidptr, aligned_4; vm_compute; intuition discriminate.
      * apply entry_word_store; reflexivity.
  - unfold naive_C_Rules.store_ptr; split.
    + unfold isvalidptr, aligned_4; vm_compute; intuition discriminate.
    + apply entry_word_store; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma singleton_entry_heap :
  (4096 # Int |-> (-2147483648) ** 4100 # Ptr |-> 0 ** 4104 # Ptr |-> 0 **
   DLLLeft 0 4096 nil ** DLLRight 0 4096 nil)
    (entry_state (entry_mem singleton_bytes)).
Proof.
  eapply entry_state_sep with
    (a := entry_mem singleton_bytes) (b := empty_mem).
  - apply mem_join_emp2.
  - eapply entry_state_sep with
      (a := entry_mem singleton_bytes) (b := empty_mem).
    + apply mem_join_emp2.
    + apply singleton_fields.
    + change (0 = 0 /\ emp (entry_state empty_mem)).
      split; [reflexivity | apply entry_state_emp].
  - change (0 = 0 /\ emp (entry_state empty_mem)).
    split; [reflexivity | apply entry_state_emp].
Qed.

Theorem resolved_remove_precondition_wit_1 : Goal.remove_precondition_wit_1.
Proof.
  unfold Goal.remove_precondition_wit_1.
  exists (@nil Z), (@nil Z), 0, 0, (-2147483648), 4096.
  intro Hfalse.
  unfold naive_C_Rules.derivable1 in Hfalse.
  apply (Hfalse (entry_state (entry_mem singleton_bytes))).

  exact singleton_entry_heap.
Qed.


Module Proofs.
Definition proof_of_remove_precondition_wit_1 : Goal.remove_precondition_wit_1 := resolved_remove_precondition_wit_1.

Import ListNotations.
Local Open Scope sac.
Local Open Scope Z_scope.

(* A finite byte map, with no permissions outside the listed addresses. *)
Fixpoint entry_mem (bs : list (Z * Z)) : mem :=
  match bs with
  | nil => empty_mem
  | (p, b) :: tl =>
      fun x => if Z.eqb x p then value b else entry_mem tl x
  end.

Definition entry_state (m : mem) : naive_C_Rules.model :=
  {| ConAssertion.s_mem := m;
     ConAssertion.s_STS := Sets.full;
     ConAssertion.s_token := Sets.empty |}.

Lemma entry_state_join : forall a b c,
  mem_join a b c ->
  naive_C_Rules.join (entry_state a) (entry_state b) (entry_state c).
Proof.
  intros a b c H.
  unfold naive_C_Rules.join, ConAssertion.state_join, entry_state; cbn.
  split; [exact H |].
  unfold ConAssertion.TokenSet_join, ConAssertion.STS_state_join.
  sets_unfold; tauto.
Qed.

Lemma entry_state_emp : emp (entry_state empty_mem).
Proof.
  unfold naive_C_Rules.emp, naive_C_Rules.is_unit,
    ConAssertion.state_empty, entry_state; cbn.
  split; [apply empty_mem_empty |].
  sets_unfold; tauto.
Qed.

Lemma entry_state_byte : forall p b,
  naive_C_Rules.mstore p b (entry_state (single_byte_mem p b)).
Proof.
  intros p b.
  unfold naive_C_Rules.mstore, entry_state.
  exists b; split; [apply Byte.eqm_refl |].
  repeat split; try reflexivity; sets_unfold; tauto.
Qed.

Lemma entry_state_sep : forall (P Q : naive_C_Rules.expr) a b c,
  mem_join a b c -> P (entry_state a) -> Q (entry_state b) ->
  (P ** Q) (entry_state c).
Proof.
  intros P Q a b c Hjoin HP HQ.
  pose proof (entry_state_join a b c Hjoin) as Hstate.
  exists (entry_state a), (entry_state b); tauto.
Qed.

Lemma entry_mem_absent : forall bs x,
  ~ In x (map fst bs) -> entry_mem bs x = Noperm.
Proof.
  induction bs as [| [p b] tl IH]; intros x H.
  - reflexivity.
  - cbn [entry_mem].
    destruct (Z.eqb x p) eqn:E.
    + apply Z.eqb_eq in E; subst x.
      exfalso; apply H; cbn; left; reflexivity.
    + apply IH; intro Hin; apply H; cbn; right; exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma entry_mem_app_join : forall l r,
  (forall x, In x (map fst l) -> ~ In x (map fst r)) ->
  mem_join (entry_mem l) (entry_mem r) (entry_mem (l ++ r)).
Proof.
  induction l as [| [p b] tl IH]; intros r Hd.
  - apply mem_join_emp1.
  - unfold mem_join; intro x; cbn [entry_mem List.app].
    destruct (Z.eqb x p) eqn:E.
    + apply Z.eqb_eq in E; subst x.
      assert (Hr : entry_mem r p = Noperm).
      { apply entry_mem_absent; apply Hd; cbn; left; reflexivity. }
      rewrite Hr.
      do 4 right; exists b; repeat split; reflexivity.
    + assert (Ht : forall y, In y (map fst tl) -> ~ In y (map fst r)).
      { intros y Hy; apply Hd; cbn; right; exact Hy. }
      exact (IH r Ht x).
Qed.

Lemma entry_mem_sep : forall (P Q : naive_C_Rules.expr) l r,
  (forall x, In x (map fst l) -> ~ In x (map fst r)) ->
  P (entry_state (entry_mem l)) -> Q (entry_state (entry_mem r)) ->
  (P ** Q) (entry_state (entry_mem (l ++ r))).
Proof.
  intros P Q l r Hd HP HQ.
  eapply entry_state_sep; [apply entry_mem_app_join; exact Hd | exact HP | exact HQ].
Qed.

Definition entry_word (p a b c d : Z) : list (Z * Z) :=
  [(p, a); (p + 1, b); (p + 2, c); (p + 3, d)].

Lemma entry_word_store : forall p a b c d v,
  merge_int a b c d v ->
  naive_C_Rules.store_4byte p v
    (entry_state (entry_mem (entry_word p a b c d))).
Proof.
  intros p a b c d v Hmerge.
  unfold naive_C_Rules.store_4byte.
  exists a, b, c, d; split; [exact Hmerge |].
  eapply entry_mem_sep with
    (l := [(p, a)]) (r := [(p + 1, b); (p + 2, c); (p + 3, d)]).
  - cbn; intros x Hin Hout.
    destruct Hin as [Hin | []]; subst x.
    destruct Hout as [Hout | [Hout | [Hout | []]]]; lia.
  - apply entry_state_byte.
  - eapply entry_mem_sep with
      (l := [(p + 1, b)]) (r := [(p + 2, c); (p + 3, d)]).
    + cbn; intros x Hin Hout.
      destruct Hin as [Hin | []]; subst x.
      destruct Hout as [Hout | [Hout | []]]; lia.
    + apply entry_state_byte.
    + eapply entry_mem_sep with (l := [(p + 2, c)]) (r := [(p + 3, d)]).
      * cbn; intros x Hin Hout.
        destruct Hin as [Hin | []]; subst x.
        destruct Hout as [Hout | []]; lia.
      * apply entry_state_byte.
      * apply entry_state_byte.
Qed.

From SimpleC.Verification Require Import VCPrelude.
Require Import Goal DLLSupplement.
From Coq Require Import ZArith List Bool Lia.
From SimpleC.SL Require Import Mem.
Require Import SetsClass.SetsClass.
Import ListNotations SetsNotation.
Import naive_C_Rules.
Local Open Scope sac.
Local Open Scope Z_scope.

(* Finite byte heaps, with the same STS and token components as a byte store. *)
Fixpoint finite_memory (bs : list (Z * Z)) : mem :=
  match bs with
  | [] => empty_mem
  | (p, b) :: tl =>
      fun x => if addr_eqb x p then value b else finite_memory tl x
  end.

Definition finite_state (m : mem) : naive_C_Rules.model :=
  {| ConAssertion.s_mem := m;
     ConAssertion.s_STS := Sets.full;
     ConAssertion.s_token := Sets.empty |}.

Definition bytes_disjointb (xs ys : list (Z * Z)) : bool :=
  forallb
    (fun ab => forallb (fun cd => negb (Z.eqb (fst ab) (fst cd))) ys)
    xs.

Lemma finite_memory_present : forall bs p,
  finite_memory bs p <> Noperm -> exists b, In (p, b) bs.
Proof.
  induction bs as [| [a b] tl IH]; intros p H.
  - exfalso. apply H. reflexivity.
  - cbn [finite_memory] in H.
    destruct (addr_eqb p a) eqn:E.
    + apply addr_eqb_eq in E. subst a.
      exists b. left. reflexivity.
    + destruct (IH p H) as [c Hc]. exists c. right. exact Hc.
Qed.

Lemma finite_memory_app : forall xs ys p,
  finite_memory (xs ++ ys) p =
  match finite_memory xs p with
  | Noperm => finite_memory ys p
  | v => v
  end.
Proof.
  induction xs as [| [a b] tl IH]; intros ys p.
  - reflexivity.
  - cbn [List.app finite_memory].
    destruct (addr_eqb p a); [reflexivity | apply IH].
Qed.

Lemma bytes_disjointb_sound : forall xs ys,
  bytes_disjointb xs ys = true ->
  forall p b c, In (p, b) xs -> In (p, c) ys -> False.
Proof.
  unfold bytes_disjointb.
  intros xs ys H p b c Hx Hy.
  rewrite forallb_forall in H. specialize (H (p, b) Hx).
  rewrite forallb_forall in H. specialize (H (p, c) Hy).
  cbn in H. rewrite Z.eqb_refl in H. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma finite_memory_join : forall xs ys,
  bytes_disjointb xs ys = true ->
  mem_join (finite_memory xs) (finite_memory ys)
           (finite_memory (xs ++ ys)).
Proof.
  intros xs ys Hd.
  assert (Hdis : forall p,
    finite_memory xs p <> Noperm ->
    finite_memory ys p <> Noperm -> False).
  {
    intros p Hx Hy.
    destruct (finite_memory_present xs p Hx) as [b Hb].
    destruct (finite_memory_present ys p Hy) as [c Hc].
    exact (bytes_disjointb_sound xs ys Hd p b c Hb Hc).
  }
  unfold mem_join. intro p. rewrite finite_memory_app.
  destruct (finite_memory xs p) eqn:Hx;
    destruct (finite_memory ys p) eqn:Hy;
    cbn; try solve [eauto 8].
  all: exfalso; apply (Hdis p); congruence.

  mem_join a b c ->
  naive_C_Rules.join (finite_state a) (finite_state b) (finite_state c).
Proof.
  intros a b c H.
  unfold naive_C_Rules.join, ConAssertion.state_join, finite_state.
  cbn. split; [exact H |].
  unfold ConAssertion.TokenSet_join, ConAssertion.STS_state_join.
  sets_unfold. tauto.

  bytes_disjointb xs ys = true ->
  P (finite_state (finite_memory xs)) ->
  Q (finite_state (finite_memory ys)) ->
  (P ** Q) (finite_state (finite_memory (xs ++ ys))).
Proof.
  intros P Q xs ys Hd HP HQ.
  assert (HJ : naive_C_Rules.join
    (finite_state (finite_memory xs))
    (finite_state (finite_memory ys))
    (finite_state (finite_memory (xs ++ ys)))).
  { apply finite_state_join. apply finite_memory_join. exact Hd. }
  unfold naive_C_Rules.sepcon.

  tauto.

  naive_C_Rules.store_byte p b

  cbn [forallb fst];

Proof.

  match bs with

      fun x => if Z.eqb x p then value b else entry_mem tl x
  end.

    + apply IH; intro Hin; apply H; cbn; right; exact Hin.

 destruct (reassociate_join c b a bc m (naive_C_Rules.join_comm _ _ _ k) (naive_C_Rules.join_comm _ _ _ j)) as [ba [l r]].
 exists ba,c; split; [apply naive_C_Rules.join_comm; exact r|split; [exists a,b; split; [apply naive_C_Rules.join_comm; exact l|tauto]|exact hc]]. Qed.
Lemma ret_bubble (A B C:expr) : A**(B**C) |-- B**(A**C).
Proof. eapply ret_trans; [apply ret_unassoc|]. eapply ret_trans; [apply ret_map; [apply ret_swap|apply ret_id]|apply ret_assoc]. Qed.
Lemma ret_add_emp (A E:expr) (emptyE:forall m, emp m -> E m) : A |-- A ** E.
Proof. intros m h. destruct (naive_C_Rules.unit_join m) as [u [e j]]. exists m,u; split; [exact j|split; [exact h|apply emptyE, e]]. Qed.
Lemma ret_fold (n p q v:Z) ll lr (N:n <> 0) :
 (((n+0) # Int |-> v) ** ((n+4) # Ptr |-> p) ** ((n+8) # Ptr |-> q) ** DLLLeft p n ll ** DLLRight q n lr) |-- Dll n ll v lr.
Proof. intros m h; right; split; [exact N|exists p,q; exact h]. Qed.
Lemma ret_fold_left (n curr prev v:Z) tl (N:n <> 0) :
 (((n+0) # Int |-> v) ** ((n+4) # Ptr |-> prev) ** ((n+8) # Ptr |-> curr) ** DLLLeft prev n tl) |-- DLLLeft n curr (v::tl).
Proof. intros m h; split; [exact N|exists prev; exact h]. Qed.
Ltac ret_lift lemma :=
 first [exact lemma | apply ret_map; [ret_lift lemma|apply ret_id] | apply ret_map; [apply ret_id|ret_lift lemma]].
Ltac ret_pull a :=
 lazymatch goal with
 | |- (a ** _) |-- _ => apply ret_id
 | |- (_ ** a) |-- _ => apply ret_swap
 | |- (?x ** ?y) |-- _ => eapply ret_trans; [apply ret_map; [apply ret_id|ret_pull a]|apply ret_bubble]
 end.
Ltac ret_arrange :=
 lazymatch goal with
 | |- ?a |-- ?a => apply ret_id
 | |- ((?a ** ?b) ** ?c) |-- _ => eapply ret_trans; [apply ret_assoc|ret_arrange]
 | |- _ |-- ((?a ** ?b) ** ?c) => eapply ret_trans; [|apply ret_unassoc];ret_arrange
 | |- _ |-- (?a ** ?b) => eapply ret_trans; [ret_pull a | apply ret_map; [apply ret_id|ret_arrange]]
 end.
